title: Lukewarm
summary: LU'KEWARM, adjective 1. Moderately warm; tepid; as lukewarm water; lukewarm heat. 2. Not ardent; not zealous; cool; indifferent; as lukewarm obedience; lukewarm patriots. Revelation 3:16.
